architecture: Local engineering proposal based on archived owner and source task, not mandated by external docs

sources.fact: -r recurses, -l adds blob size, -z uses NUL termination and verbatim paths; --full-tree ignores current-directory restriction.
Binary mode avoids newline conversion. communicate buffers captured data. Waiting with undrained pipes can deadlock; timeout cleanup requires terminating and reaping the process.
mktree constructs a tree from ls-tree style input; -z accepts NUL-delimited input. Used only in synthetic fixture generator.
